name: Docker Login
description: GitHub Action to login against a Docker registry

registry.description: Server address of Docker registry. If not set then will default to Docker Hub

username.description: Username used to log against the Docker registry

password.description: Password or personal access token used to log against the Docker registry

ecr.description: Specifies whether the given registry is ECR (auto, true or false)

logout.description: Log out from the Docker registry at the end of a job
